Unchanged A13 native geometry and routing groups from [core-ddr-benchmark](https://github.com/ShiboSoftwareDev/core-ddr-benchmark/tree/24dc44c166d4258c3538f8b1f66953f1b6f58690). `source.json` is the decompressed `circuits/a13.json.gz`; the two native component files are copied verbatim. Board coordinates are millimeters, +X right and +Y up. Route the original four data bytes before the remaining 64 signals, with the original layer and clearance rules.
